title: Taking Dominion Over Commercial Real Estate
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful message about the church's next chapter, calling believers to arise and shine, taking ownership of commercial real estate and expanding the kingdom of God in Kansas City and beyond. With prophetic insight and a sense of excitement, Pastor Chris reveals a vision for the church's future, one that includes multiple locations and a supernatural move of God. Don't miss this inspiring sermon as Pastor Chris shares a glimpse of what's to come and calls believers to get ready to be a part of it.
